Bragin

By: Tarryn Crossman | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
we confront a bully of the worst kind, a grown man verbally abusing woman and children.

Unique Selling Point:

This story will speak to adults too, its about the bully in the office as much as the bully in the schooling system.

Summary:
Llewelyn Bragin is a seasoned bully, ruling through power and dominance. Hiding behind a ‘strong leadership style’, he belittles and abuses both staff and students.

He is the principle of a top all boys preparatory school in Pietermaritzburg.
A school that prides itself on being a leading specialist institution for boys. Yet, he stands accused of sexual harassment, bullying staff and verbally abusing boys as young as 7.

Gift, the head of sports was so destroyed by Bragin constantly berating him that he started working longer hours to try and be perfect, he stopped eating properly, stopped sleeping and lost all confidence in himself.
Eventually, after trying to commit suicide, he checked into a clinic and was diagnosed with depression.

Melissa was Bragins PA, he harassed her from day one making wildly sexually inappropriate comments like – "If I wasn’t married I would F-k you sideways." She tried to ignore him and just wanted to hold onto her job, but when he took two weeks mental health leave, she immediately confided in the deputy principle. More staff came forward, and eventually the deputy had 52 complaints against Bragin. 52 grown adults who for nearly 2 years had been suffering in silence, too afraid to lose their jobs or stand up to the bully.


But it wasn’t just the adults he was bullying and abusing. Rourke, aged 9, was a boarder at Merchiston suffering from separation anxiety which the school was aware of. One day Rourke had a full-blown panic attack, and no-one could get near him. Bragin heard the commotion and ran towards Rourke screaming “if you don’t calm down, I will call the police, and have you sent to a juvenile center and you will never see your mother again”
Rourke was removed from the school by his parents and has not been back to any school in two years. He is now home schooled and is seeing a play therapist regularly to get over the PTSD of that day.

But BRAGINs reign of terror didn’t start at Merchiston.
Previously He was the senior deputy principle at another upstanding private boy’s preparatory school, Kind Edward VII in Johannesburg.
Where one woman, Sam Thorne, tried to stand up to him and was retrenched.
She built a dossier on Bragins abusive behaviour and tried to get anyone to listen, but neither the GDE nor SACE would hear her. When things started to get hot at KEPS he moved to Merchiston, but this time there were enough people to stand up against Bragin.

The SGB took the KZNDOE to court to have Bragin removed. DOE held a hearing and he was charged on 11 counts including misappropriation of funds
He was found not guilty on every count except the funds, as there was a paper trail.
Main comments from DOE – must we dismiss someone now for complementing someone
Rourke – his mom took too long to complain, so it couldn’t have been that serious

Bragin was reinstated and reported for duty at the end of July, but the parents locked him out the school and refused to budge.

The fight to stop Bragin coming back to Merchiston continues in court for now, but the bigger picture is why is the DOE fighting to keep this obvious toxic human in the schooling system?
